title: We Built Minecrafts LARGEST Storage System
description:
It's finally here, wavetechs new main storage. In this video we look at the massive main storage complex that we designed for the Wavetech server. This project has been months in the making and there have been plenty of hurdles along the way. Be sure to check out Zivon's spotify where you can find music such as the track I used for the build timelapse.
